# Native run

The original observations cover anonymous describe assertions and check-only deployment of qualified and unqualified test classes at API 62.0 and 67.0. The test methods were not executed. The original run provenance was not independently verified.

The separate `one_day_describe` capture repeats the anonymous describe controls. The `namespace_recap` capture repeats the subscriber deployment checks against a synthetic installed provider package at both API versions. Original result rows remain unchanged.
